conventions.import: Import components from kit/index.ts and the styles once from kit/kit.css, after the brand token CSS.
conventions.className: Every component and part accepts className unless its entry says "className": false; className is never listed in props.
conventions.passthrough: Props not listed forward to the passthrough type; a listed one marked "x-from": "base-ui" is a passthrough prop worth knowing.
conventions.x-type: A prop JSON cannot carry: node (any React child), element (one React element), function, or object (a DOM node or a ref).
conventions.brands: Brands differ through token values only. There is no brand, theme or style variant prop.

Button.description: A button on Base UI with a text label; while loading it ignores presses, stays focusable, is announced busy and keeps its width.

variant.description: primary: accent fill, one per view for the main action. secondary: layer fill with a hairline. quiet: text only.

size.description: m is 44px tall. s draws 32px and keeps a 44px hit area that reaches past its box.

loading.description: Shows a spinner over the label, blocks presses, stays focusable and sets aria-busy.

disabled.description: Blocks presses and removes the button from the tab order; prefer loading while an action is in progress.

focusableWhenDisabled.description: Keeps a disabled button in the tab order. The kit forces it on while loading, whatever you pass.

type.description: The native button type; set submit on the button that sends a form.

useWhen: A press runs an action on this page: save, send, delete, open a dialog.
Submitting a form, with type submit.

avoidWhen.text: The press goes to another page or URL.
The action has no words, only an icon.

a11y: Write a label that names the action (Save changes), not Click here or OK.
Give size s buttons at least var(--space-12) between neighbours, so each keeps its whole 44px hit area.
Keep the label while loading: it stays the accessible name.

IconButton.description: A square Button holding one icon and no visible text; it warns in development when it has no accessible name.

aria-label.description: The accessible name, naming the action: Undo, Close, Add orbit.

aria-labelledby.description: The id of a visible element that names the action, instead of aria-label.

useWhen: A familiar action in a toolbar or a dense row where the icon alone is understood: close, undo, more.

avoidWhen.text: The action needs words to be understood.
The press goes to another page or URL.

a11y: Give it an aria-label or aria-labelledby that names the action; the icon alone announces nothing.
Mark the icon svg aria-hidden="true" so it adds nothing to the name.
Give size s icon buttons at least var(--space-12) between neighbours, so each keeps its 44px hit area.

Checkbox.description: A checkbox on Base UI; inside Field.Root it takes the field's label, description, error and state, and shows a dash when mixed.

checked.description: Whether it is ticked, when you control it; pair with onCheckedChange. Use defaultChecked otherwise.

defaultChecked.description: Whether it starts ticked, when it manages its own state.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the new checked value when the person ticks or unticks it.

indeterminate.description: Shows a dash and announces mixed, for a box that sums up a group that is partly ticked. It wins over checked.

disabled.description: Blocks toggling and removes it from the tab order. Field.Root disabled does the same and mutes the label.

required.description: The form cannot be sent until it is ticked; sets aria-required.

name.description: The name submitted with the form. Inside Field.Root, the field's name wins.

useWhen: One yes or no choice that takes effect when the form is sent: include charts, email me.
A tick the person must give before an action, such as agreeing to terms.

avoidWhen.text: Exactly one option of a set may be picked.
The choice runs an action the moment it is pressed.

a11y: Wrap the Checkbox and its text in Field.Label inside Field.Root, so the text names it and a click on it toggles.
When a tick is required and missing, set invalid on Field.Root and say what to do in Field.Error with match.
Use indeterminate only on a box that sums up a group of boxes, and keep it in step with them.

Dialog.description: A modal dialog on Base UI: focus is trapped while open, Escape and an outside press close it, and focus returns to the trigger.

Root.description: Holds the open state; it renders no element of its own.

open.description: Controls the open state; pair it with onOpenChange.

defaultOpen.description: Opens the dialog on first render when the state is not controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Called with the next open state whenever the dialog asks to open or close.

Trigger.description: The button that opens the dialog; it renders a kit Button.

variant.description: The Button variant; unset, it is the Button default, secondary.

size.description: The Button size; unset, it is the Button default, m.

Popup.description: The backdrop, viewport and dialog box in one part, in a portal on document.body (a nested dialog's goes in its parent's).

container.description: The element, or a ref to it, the portal mounts into instead of document.body.

finalFocus.description: What takes focus on close: a ref, a function returning an element, or false. Needed when the trigger may be gone by then.

initialFocus.description: What takes focus on open: a ref, a function returning an element, or false. Default: the first tabbable element.

Header.description: A layout row for the title and the corner close control.

Title.description: The heading that names the dialog; Base UI points the popup's aria-labelledby at it.

Description.description: The supporting text; Base UI points the popup's aria-describedby at it.

Actions.description: A layout row for the dialog's buttons, at the end of the popup.

Close.description: A button that closes the dialog; it renders a kit Button unless render gives another element.

variant.description: The Button variant; unset, it is the Button default, secondary.

size.description: The Button size; unset, it is the Button default, m.

render.description: Another element to close with, in place of the kit Button.

CloseIcon.description: The corner close control, a quiet size s IconButton already named for screen readers.

label.description: The accessible name; change it only to translate it or to name what closes.

useWhen: A decision or a short task that must be finished or dismissed before going on: confirm a delete, rename.

avoidWhen.text: The content is long or is a page of its own.
A short message that needs no answer.

a11y: Give every Dialog.Popup a Dialog.Title; it is the dialog's accessible name.
If the trigger can unmount while the dialog is open, pass finalFocus on Dialog.Popup.
Offer a visible way out: a Dialog.CloseIcon in the header or a Dialog.Close in the actions.

Field.description: A labelled form field on Base UI that wires its label, description and error to the control inside it.

Root.description: Groups one control with its label, description and error, and holds the field's invalid and disabled state.

invalid.description: Marks the control aria-invalid and data-invalid (the heavy outline). It does not show Field.Error; that needs match.

disabled.description: Disables the control and mutes the label.

name.description: The control's name when the form is submitted.

Label.description: The visible label; it is the control's accessible name through a for/id pair set by Base UI.

Description.description: A hint below the control, joined to its aria-describedby.

Error.description: The error message, joined to aria-describedby; it renders only on match, a failed native check or a form error.

match.description: true renders it, even when disabled; a ValidityState key renders it while that native check fails. Use match={!!error}.

useWhen: Any text input, so it has a visible label, an optional hint and an error said in words.

avoidWhen.text: One question answered with several controls, such as a set of radios.

a11y: Give every Field.Root a Field.Label; a placeholder is not a label.
When the value is wrong, set invalid on Field.Root and match on Field.Error, and say what to fix in words.
Put format rules in Field.Description before the person types, not only in the error.

Input.description: A text input; inside Field.Root it takes the field's label, description, error and invalid and disabled state.

type.description: The native input type: text, email, password, search, tel, url, number.

readOnly.description: Shows a value that cannot be edited on a layer fill; it stays focusable and is still submitted.

autoComplete.description: The autofill hint, such as email, name or current-password.

useWhen: One line of text inside Field.Root: a name, an email, a URL, a search term.

avoidWhen.text: The text runs to more than one line.
The person picks from a fixed short list.

a11y: Place it inside Field.Root with a Field.Label; on its own it has no name unless you give it aria-label.
Set autoComplete on fields that ask for the person's own data, such as email or name.
